description: Access UN ICTR/MICT case documents database (ucr.irmct.org) - retrieve case details,  judgments, decisions, orders, transcripts, and other legal documents from International  Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and Mechanism for International Criminal Tribunals cases.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_case_detail: Get case information (defendant name, case ID); 参数: case_number; 必填: case_number
  - get_documents: Get documents for a case, optionally filtered by language or type; 参数: case_number, language, doc_type; 必填: case_number
  - get_documents_by_category: Get documents grouped by document type; 参数: case_number; 必填: case_number
  - search_documents: Search documents with text query and date filters; 参数: case_number, query, date_from, date_to; 必填: case_number

case_number.description:
Case number in format ICTR-XX-XX or MICT-XX-XX (e.g., "ICTR-97-23", "MICT-13-38").
Required for all functions.

language.description:
Language filter for documents. Values: ENG (English), FRA (French), 
KIN (Kinyarwanda), HBS (Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian), OTH (Other).
Used by get_documents function.

doc_type.description:
Document type filter. Common values: Jdg (Judgement), Dec (Decision), 
Ord (Order), TRA (Transcript), IND (Indictment), MOT (Motion), 
APP (Application), WIT (Witness List). Used by get_documents function.

query.description: Text search query to filter documents by title. Used by search_documents function.

date_from.description: Start date filter in DD/MM/YYYY format. Used by search_documents function.

date_to.description: End date filter in DD/MM/YYYY format. Used by search_documents function.
